import openpyxl
from openpyxl.styles import Border, Side, Font

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook('/workspace/task/output.xlsx')
ws = wb['SKUs as Bins']

formula = ('=LEN(B{r})-LEN(SUBSTITUTE(B{r},", ",""))+1'
           '-(IF(OR(LEFT(B{r},1)="X",LEFT(B{r},1)="Z"),1,0)'
           '+LEN(B{r})-LEN(SUBSTITUTE(B{r},", X",""))'
           '+LEN(B{r})-LEN(SUBSTITUTE(B{r},", Z","")))')

thin = Side(style='thin')
border = Border(left=thin, right=thin, top=thin, bottom=thin)
font = Font(name='Courier New', size=9)

for r in range(2, 7):
    cell = ws.cell(row=r, column=3)
    cell.value = formula.format(r=r)
    cell.border = border
    cell.font = font

wb.save('/workspace/task/output.xlsx')
print("done")
